message: I was thinking about how often we rely on our phones for everything, especially during travel. But what happens when the battery dies just when you need directions or information? That's why having a solid plan for your car is so important. It’s a good idea to know what to keep in your vehicle and how to prepare for unexpected moments. After all, a little foresight can help you feel more at ease on the road. What’s one thing you always keep in your car?
